n1.text: You are sitting in {jokerCaravan} while Robin taps a top hat. "One red silk scarf, coming up." With a flourish, Robin pulls out... a warm bread roll. Robin stares at it. "That is not a scarf."

n2.text: Soft, golden, still warm, and very good. Robin taps the hat again and a second roll pops out. "I may have invented something," Robin says, "just not what I meant to."

choices.label: Carry the hat to the baker
Take some rolls to King Kenny

n3.text: You peek inside. Flour dusts the lining, and a tag is stitched in: "Property of the baker." Robin groans. "I borrowed the wrong hat. Mine must still be at {bakery}."

choices.label: Walk the hat to the bakery

n4.text: At {bakery}, the baker laughs and holds up Robin's hat. "Three red scarves have come out of my oven this morning. I wondered why my loaves looked so fashionable."

choices.label: Suggest Robin try the trick again

n5.text: In {kingHall}, King Kenny accepts a roll with great ceremony. Robin taps the hat; another appears, then another. "Splendid," says the King. "A magician who also caters."

choices.label: Ask for a proper scarf trick
Settle in and share the rolls

n6.text: In {jackWorkshop}, Jack turns the hat over with a small lens. "False bottom, and the hinge is loose," he says. "It hands out whatever was in here last." Robin hums. "Bread, apparently."

choices.label: Take the hat to the baker

n7.text: Hats swapped, Robin tips the right one and a red scarf floats out. The baker applauds and presses a warm loaf into your hands. "For the confusing morning." You eat a good piece on the way home, quite content.

n8.text: Back in {jokerCaravan}, Robin tries once more. Out comes a red scarf with a single small roll tucked in its folds. "Call it a bonus," Robin says, bowing. You clap, and the roll gets shared.

n9.text: Robin tries again. Out comes a red scarf, and the King wraps it around his shoulders, delighted. Then, with a little cough, the hat produces one last roll. "Encore!" says Kenny. Everyone agrees it was the best trick, mistake and all.

n10.text: You and the King sit down with the rolls and a pot of tea while Robin keeps the hat going. By the twelfth roll, nobody is counting. It is the most pleasant, unplanned lunch in a long while.

n11.text: Jack tightens the hinge with a tiny screwdriver and tests it with a handkerchief. It comes out a handkerchief. "Boring," says Robin, "but reliable." Jack hands you a roll he saved from earlier. "For the helper."
